subject: [Webinar invitation] World Models for Physical AI – May 22nd
text:
Hi Daniel,

Hope you’re doing well!

I wanted to personally invite you to a Webinar we’re hosting on May 22nd that I think you’ll find really interesting.

We’ve been digging into some of the latest breakthroughs in World Models (like NVIDIA’s GR00T N1 and Dreamer), and how they’re opening up new ways for machines to actually understand and act in complex real-world environments.

Our team at Encord will be walking through how to apply these models in practical, high-stakes workflows—think robotics, autonomous systems, industrial AI, etc.

Here’s what we’ll cover:
How World Models can unlock richer, more reliable real-world interactions Methods for spotting and correcting edge cases in huge sensor datasets A faster way to build clean, VLA-aligned datasets for deployment If you are up for it, you can register here: https://encord.com/webinar/world-models-for-physical-ai/?utm_source=hubspot&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may+25+webinar&utm_content=outbound+email.

Hope to see you there!

Best regards,
Sofia from Encord
